ratings.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable, 7 good with meaningful friction, 9 excellent, 10 exceptional within observed scope. Holistic judgment, not an average of mission wins or terminal score; unassessed content earns no assumed enjoyment.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent, finishable touch mission with useful guidance and convincing visual atmosphere; target size, turn-induced disorientation and HUD competition create meaningful friction. Limited manual samples and frequent pauses constrain confidence.
reasons.controls: MOVE plus FIRE drag worked in opening and patrol engagements on both attempts; scene swipe visibly changed heading. Large anchored controls help. Tap aim rotated sharply and one movement left pillar occlusion; true thumb ergonomics and sustained rearming remain unknown.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, numbered coils with armor/open states and deck defense form understandable progression. Target confirmations and reload offer readable feedback. Much traversal used assistance and many threats were bypassed; these runs do not establish unassisted combat depth or continuous enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Rain, dark teal architecture, warm lighting, weapon silhouette and cohesive title/result screens support the setting. Static views are attractive; audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Objective checkmarks, contextual hold labels, route cues, map and explicit START FRESH made two full runs manageable. Map was easy to close. Threat directions sometimes compete with objective guidance and require reorientation.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo, clear terminal results and colored OFF/checkmarks read well at 844x390. Distant targets, environmental signs and compact armor/timing text are harder; prompts occupy significant scene area.

coverage.manualMoveAndFireDrag: Opening guard and visible left perimeter patrol, simultaneous two-contact MOVE/FIRE drag; TARGET DOWN and SENTINEL DOWN observed.
coverage.map: Opened at MAP FIND ENTRY; viewed planning map, visibly closed.
coverage.assistedCompletion: HOLD ROUTE/HOLD APPROACH for three recoveries, Custodian approach and deck; tap aim plus anchored FIRE for coils and deck enemies.
coverage.missesAndCorrections: Coil II magazine emptied at 28%; reload then armor chip feedback at 17%; another burst disabled it. Third remaining coil required following route closer. Exact shot-level misses not distinguishable; terminal accuracy 82%.

ratings.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional. Holistic subjective scores for observed portrait emulation only, not win/loss grades or arithmetic average.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, completable portrait mission with generous visible aids and atmospheric presentation; small targets, dense HUD and occasional orientation friction limit confidence. Both wins alone do not determine this grade.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE/FIRE drag and scene swipe responded; tap centering and warnings help. Manual samples were assisted, with little fine correction required; continuous ergonomics/rearming remain unknown.
reasons.gameplay: Observed recover/coil/upload progression offers understandable changes and defensive encounters. Route and tap aids dominated these samples, limiting judgment of movement depth, challenge and sustained enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber visual identity, rain, industrial geometry and readable terminal screen. Audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, changing hold labels, map, checkmarks, automatic reload and explicit START FRESH support progress; concealed coil entry and TURN orientation needed additional interpretation.
reasons.readability: Core health/ammo/objectives and OFF/upload states clear; thin small labels, distant silhouettes and stacked threat information harder at 390x844.
